rows.question: How does Pay-in-3 work?
rows.answer: Payly Pay-in-3 splits an eligible purchase of $30 to $600 into three payments. 34% of the order total is charged at checkout, and the remaining two payments of 33% each are charged 14 and 28 days after checkout. There is no interest, and Payly never charges more than the displayed schedule except for the late fee described in the Late Payments policy.

rows.question: Will I be charged a late fee on my Tessera Games order?

rows.question: Can I reschedule my payment for the Aria Travel order?
rows.answer: You can reschedule your payment for the Aria Travel order, but you must do so at least 24 hours before the original due date. You can move the due date of one upcoming installment per order, up to 7 days later, from the app. The first installment charged at checkout cannot be rescheduled.

rows.question: Can I move my next payment a few days later?

rows.question: How do refunds work?
rows.answer: Refunds are applied to your Payly order automatically when a merchant accepts a return. If the merchant has not confirmed a return after 30 days, you can ask for a case review. Refunds are processed within 5 business days after the merchant confirms the return to Payly. A refund first cancels upcoming installments, newest first, and then returns money for installments that were already paid to your original payment method.

rows.question: Can I use Payly at stores that aren't integrated?
rows.answer: You can use Payly at stores that aren't integrated with our service using the virtual card feature. The virtual card is generated in the app and is valid for a single purchase. The purchase amount with the virtual card is between $30 and $600 in the United States.

rows.question: What happens if I miss a payment?
rows.answer: If you miss a payment, Payly will retry it automatically after 2 days and again after 5 days. A late fee of $7 will be applied once per installment if the payment is still unpaid 3 days after the due date, and it will never exceed 25% of the installment amount. While an installment is past due, you cannot start new Payly orders. Updating the payment method in the app and paying the overdue installment will restore your account the same day.

rows.question: Is there interest on Pay-in-3?
rows.answer: There is no interest on Pay-in-3. Payly never charges more than the displayed schedule except for the late fee described in the Late Payments policy.

rows.question: Tell me about Pay Monthly
rows.answer: Pay Monthly is available for orders between $250 and $2,500 at participating merchants. The order is split into six equal monthly installments, with the first installment charged at checkout. The APR for Pay Monthly ranges from 0% to 24.9% depending on the merchant offer. Paying off the balance early does not carry a prepayment penalty.

rows.question: Is my Atlas Furniture payment paused while the dispute is open?
rows.answer: While a dispute is open, upcoming installments for that order are paused. Installments already past due are not paused. You can check the status of your dispute and paused installments in your account.
